When [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] designer '''Joran Raider''', the mastermind behind many of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most successful [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], departed from [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] to establish his own small manufacturing firm, [[Raider Arms/Legends|Raider Arms]], it dealt a significant blow to the arms giant. Persistent rumors suggested that several notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by BlasTech to eliminate Raider were instead bribed with examples of what is widely regarded as his finest creation, the [[Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol/Legends|Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol]].<ref name="Fly" />
